QUESTIONS.t: I remember information best when I hear it in a lecture or discussion.
I read my notes out loud or talk to myself when studying.
I prefer verbal instructions over written ones.
I use rhymes or sound patterns to memorize facts.
I learn best when I can move around rather than sitting still.
I find it difficult to learn new sports or physical activities.
Role-playing or acting helps me understand complex ideas.
I tap my foot, pace, or use a stress ball to help me concentrate.
I need to physically touch objects or build models to understand a topic.
Hands-on experiments and labs are the best way for me to learn.
Highlighting key ideas and writing summaries helps me remember.
Taking notes by hand is essential to my learning process.
I remember information best by reading textbooks or handouts.
I grasp concepts faster when presented in charts, graphs, or diagrams.
I prefer watching a demonstration or video over listening to an explanation.
Color-coding my notes and using visual aids helps me memorize.
I concentrate better when I can eat snacks or chew gum while studying.
Having water or drinks available helps me maintain focus.
I feel distracted if I cannot eat or drink during long study sessions.
Sugary treats or caffeine negatively affect my study productivity.
I need bright lighting to read and concentrate effectively.
I feel sleepy or unmotivated when a room is dimly lit.
I prefer studying in low light or away from direct sunlight.
Poor lighting quickly strains my eyes and ruins my concentration.
I cannot focus if the room is too warm; I need it to be cool.
I often feel cold when studying and need extra layers.
Fluctuations in room temperature easily distract me.
I am highly sensitive to whether a space is too hot or too cold.
I find it difficult to sit in one place for a long time when learning.
I need to take physical breaks and walk around to maintain concentration.
I can concentrate perfectly well sitting still for long periods.
Moving around helps clear my head and process information.
I study best when there is background noise, like music or people talking.
Silence distracts me more than it helps me when I am trying to study.
I require a completely quiet environment to work and learn effectively.
Background music (especially instrumental) helps me focus on tasks.
I prefer studying while sitting in a soft chair or lying on the bed.
Formal desks and rigid chairs make it hard for me to concentrate.
I think best when I am relaxed informally rather than sitting up straight.
I prefer to sprawl out on the floor or a couch when doing assignments.
I am most alert and do my best work in the late afternoon or evening.
I find it very difficult to concentrate early in the morning.
I feel sluggish when forced to study before midday.
I am highly productive during the early morning hours.
I work harder when I know my teacher wants me to succeed.
I am motivated when I can ask teachers questions and get regular feedback.
I work better on assignments when my teacher is close by to help.
I rarely ask teachers for help and prefer to figure things out myself.
I learn more and work harder when in a group of peers.
I find it distracting to work with others and prefer doing it alone.
Group brainstorming sessions help me process complex information.
I feel energized when working with a team rather than working independently.
I work best when given strict, detailed, step-by-step instructions.
I prefer precise rubrics and examples of what the final work should look like.
I feel anxious if an assignment is too open-ended or lacks clear rules.
I like to make my own choices about what steps to take and resources to use.
I like to complete one task fully before moving on to the next.
I don't like leaving things unfinished once I start them.
I tend to work on multiple tasks at the same time.
I rarely get distracted and procrastinate on important assignments.
I look for and find interesting things in my studies naturally.
I do not need rewards or other people to motivate me to study.
I find it easy to spend the necessary time to learn new material.
I usually need external pressure or deadlines to get my work done.
